details.description: Llama 3.2 3B is the base (pretrained, non-instruction-tuned) checkpoint in Meta's Llama 3.2 family, released September 25, 2024, with 3.21 billion parameters. Meta pretrained it on up to 9 trillion tokens of publicly available data using an optimized transformer architecture with grouped-query attention, and positions it as a foundation checkpoint for developers to fine-tune, rather than for direct assistant-style chat. Meta's model card officially supports eight languages: English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, and Thai, with a knowledge cutoff of December 2023.
advantages: Meta reports the base model scores 58% on 5-shot MMLU, ahead of the 32.2% scored by the smaller Llama 3.2 1B base model, per its model card.
Serves as a foundation checkpoint that developers can fine-tune for custom applications, per Meta's model card.
Officially supports 8 languages: English, German, French, Italian, Portuguese, Hindi, Spanish, and Thai, per Meta's model card.
disadvantages: This is a base (pretrained) checkpoint, not instruction-tuned; Meta offers a separate Llama 3.2 3B Instruct release for assistant-style chat and dialogue.
Meta reports lower base-model MMLU accuracy (58%) than the Llama 3.1 8B base model (66.7%), per its model card.
Knowledge cutoff of December 2023, per Meta's model card.
Fireworks AI's hosted listing states the model does not support fine-tuning, serverless deployment, function calling, embeddings, reranking, or image input on its platform.
use_cases: Fine-tuning as a base for custom downstream language tasks
General natural language generation and text completion
Research and experimentation with a compact multilingual base model

sources.title: Llama 3.2: Revolutionizing edge AI and vision with open, customizable models

notes: This target's uri is the base/pretrained checkpoint (Fireworks model id 'llama-v3p2-3b', no '-instruct' suffix), distinct from the instruction-tuned Llama 3.2 3B Instruct model, which Meta releases separately. Catalog's max_input/max_output_tokens (131072) matches the 128K context that Meta and Fireworks both report for this model family. No maker or host page was found describing a deprecation or lifecycle status specific to this base checkpoint; Amazon Bedrock does not appear to list a non-instruct Llama 3.2 3B model, so no host lifecycle status is available for it. The GitHub llama3_2 MODEL_CARD.md's own 'Model Release Date' field says Oct 24, 2024, not Sept 25, 2024; Meta's Sept 25, 2024 announcement post confirms Sept 25 is correct, so that source was added. The 66.7% Llama 3.1 8B base MMLU comparison figure is on Llama 3.1's own model card, not one previously listed, so that source was added too.
